case.title: Synthetic evaluation: tune-passive-archive
case.abstract: The purpose is to compare two medieval inventories. Thirty archival records are transcribed and compared using a fixed codebook. A discrepancy is observed in 3 entries. The analysis is restricted to one archive. We conclude that the entries should not be treated as complete population counts.
